more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Octafluorocyclobutane is a fluorinated cyclic compound used as a propellant and aerating agent in specified foamed or sprayed foods. FDA describes use alone or with carbon dioxide, nitrous oxide or propane. Food-grade material must meet the regulation's purity and impurity limits. The applicable food standard must permit this use.
more_info.uses: Used as a propellant and aerating agent in specified foamed or sprayed foods. It may be used alone or with carbon dioxide, nitrous oxide or propane, subject to the US regulation and applicable food standards.
